chapterInfo.content:
31
Ahotosoɔ dwom
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ. Dawid dwom.
1Wo, AWURADE, na madwane abɛtoa woɔ,
mma m’anim nngu ase da biara da.
Fa wo tenenee so gye me,
2 # Dwom 18.2 yɛ aso ma me,
yɛ ntɛm gye me.
Yɛ me dwanekɔhyɛbea botan
ne srɔnsrɔn so aban sɛ wɔbɛgye me nkwa.
3 # Dwom 23.3 Na wone me botantim ne me tenabea srɔnsrɔn,
na wo din nti wobɛkyerɛ me kwan na woakɔgya me.
4 # Dwom 25.15 Wobɛyi me afiri afidie a wɔahunta asum me no mu,
na wo ara ne m’aban a ɛyɛ den.
5 # Luk 23.46 Wo nsam na mede me honhom mehyɛ,
AWURADE, nokorɛ Nyankopɔn, woagye me.
6Metane wɔn a wɔdi atorɔ ahuhudeɛ akyire,
na me deɛ, mebata AWURADE ho.
7Mɛdi ahurisie, na m’ani agye w’adɔeɛ ho,
sɛ woahwɛ m’amanehunu,
na woahunu me kra ahohia.
8 # Dwom 18.36 Na woanyi me anhyɛ ɔtamfoɔ nsa,
wode me nan agyina deɛ ɛtrɛ.
9 # Dwom 6.7 AWURADE, hu me mmɔbɔ,
na me ho dwan me.
Awerɛhoɔ ama m’ani ne me kra ne me honam atwintwam.
10Na me nkwa ahwere yea mu,
na me mfeɛ ahwere ahomeguo mu.
M’amumuyɛ nti m’ahoɔden so ahwan,
na me nnompe ahodwo.
11 # Dwom 69.10-12 M’ahohiahiafoɔ nyinaa nti mayɛ ɔhohorafoɔ,
na mayɛ me ho tefoɔ so duru,
na m’amannifoɔ suro me,
wɔn a mefiri adi a wɔhu me dwane me. 12Nnipa werɛ afiri me sɛ owufoɔ,
mayɛ sɛ adeɛ a wɔto twene.
13 # Yer 20.10; 46.5 Na mete nnipa bebree nsekudie,
ahudeɛ atwa me ho ahyia,
sɛdeɛ me ho agyina a wɔakorɔ no mu
wɔabɔ wɔn tirim sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me kra.
14Na me deɛ, wo, AWURADE, so na mede me ho matoɔ.
Mese: Wone me Nyankopɔn.
15 # Dwom 139.16 Wo nsam na me mmerɛ wɔ,
gye me m’atamfoɔ ne m’ataafoɔ nsam.
16 # Num 6.25; Dwom 80.3 Te w’anim kyerɛ w’akoa,
fa w’adɔeɛ so gye me nkwa.
17AWURADE mma m’anim nngu ase,
na mesu mefrɛ wo.
Ma abɔnefoɔ anim ngu ase,
na wɔntotɔre mum Asamando.
18Ma atorofoɔ ano mmua,
wɔn a wɔka ɔteneneeni ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ den
ahokyerɛ ne aniammɔho mu no.
19Wo papa a wode asie ama wɔn a wɔsuro wo no
sɛdeɛ asi so fa!
Ɛno na woyi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔdwane bɛtoa woɔ no, nnipa anim.
20 # Dwom 27.5 Wode w’anim bɔ wɔn ho ban
de wɔn hunta firi nnipa a wɔabɔ kyenku anim,
wode wɔn sie ɔsese mu
firi tɛkyerɛma birebire ho.
21 # Dwom 17.7 Nhyira ne AWURADE
sɛ wama n’adɔeɛ ayɛ nwanwa ama me,
kuro a ahohiahia wɔ.
22 # Dwom 116.11 Nso me deɛ, mekaa no m’ahoyera mu sɛ:
Wɔatwa me afiri w’ani so.
Nanso mesu mefrɛɛ woɔ no,
wotee me nkotosrɛ.
23Monnɔ AWURADE, mo a moyɛ n’ahotefoɔ nyinaa.
AWURADE hwɛ wɔn a wɔdi nokorɛ so,
na ɔtua deɛ ɔdi ahantansɛm no ka ma no boro so.
24 # Dwom 27.14 Monhyɛ mo ho den na monsi mo bo,
mo a motwɛn AWURADE nyinaa.

mma m’anim nngu ase da biara da.

yɛ aso ma me,
yɛ ntɛm gye me.

Na me nkwa ahwere yea mu,

M’ahohiahiafoɔ nyinaa nti mayɛ ɔhohorafoɔ,

Na mete nnipa bebree nsekudie,

Wo nsam na me mmerɛ wɔ,

Te w’anim kyerɛ w’akoa,

Wode w’anim bɔ wɔn ho ban

sɛ wama n’adɔeɛ ayɛ nwanwa ama me,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
